name: White Noise
source:
Created for the TyranoBuilder Gamejam 2015.

Dara, a Cyber-Ware scrounger, finds an old cartridge in the garbage and soon discovers how important it is.

Contains course[sic] language.

[From [url=http://thedoctor.itch.io/white-noise]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
为TyranoBuilder 2015年游戏创作大赛制作。

赛博装备拾荒者达拉在垃圾中发现了一盘旧卡带，很快意识到它有多么重要。

包含粗俗语言。

[来源：[url=http://thedoctor.itch.io/white-noise]Itch.io[/url]]
